title: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Working in a group is more effective than working alone. Support your opinion with specific reasons and examples.
text:
# Part 1
I strongly agree that working in a group is very valuable.
There are several reasons to support my opinion.

# Part 2 
First of all, working as a team is usually more efficient.
For example, when I was a freshman in college, I was new and had no experience. I majored in Atmospheric science and had an American teacher who was very passionate and caring.

# Part 3 
In that class, we had so many group projects./ In one particular group project, my teammates didn't work hard and weren't cooperative. /They weren't focused, which almost led to bad grades.

# Part 4
To fix this, I decided to become more engaged in the projects./ I became an active participant, and I had a lot on my plate. /I stayed diligent and had to stay up late because the teacher would give us a heavy penalty for a bad presentation.

# Part 5
In the end, we learned to support each other. Instead of not getting anything out of the class, I was able to gain more knowledge, get better grades, and broaden my horizons.

# Part 6
That's why I believe working in a group is more effective.

segments.text: I strongly agree that working in a group is very valuable.
There are several reasons to support my opinion.
First of all, working as a team is usually more efficient.
For example, when I was a freshman in college, I was new and had no experience. I majored in Atmospheric science and had an American teacher who was very passionate and caring.
In that class, we had so many group projects.
In one particular group project, my teammates didn't work hard and weren't cooperative.
They weren't focused, which almost led to bad grades.
To fix this, I decided to become more engaged in the projects.
I became an active participant, and I had a lot on my plate.
I stayed diligent and had to stay up late because the teacher would give us a heavy penalty for a bad presentation.
In the end, we learned to support each other. Instead of not getting anything out of the class, I was able to gain more knowledge, get better grades, and broaden my horizons.
That's why I believe working in a group is more effective.
